items.title: Change common-types dependency for existing 2026-11 preview versions
items.summary: The PR changes @armCommonTypesVersion from v6 to v5 for two existing preview enum members. The dependency switch propagates across 109 ARM operations, producing 237 request and response wire-schema differences while downstream SDK contracts remain equivalent.

findings.expected: Operation RegistryDevices_Update preserves the existing wire contract for response default.
findings.rationale: This is a concrete request or response wire-schema difference caused by changing the common-types dependency of existing API versions; existing clients can observe the contract change.

intentAssessments.title: Existing API versions change wire contracts
intentAssessments.expected: Preserve the wire contract of existing API versions, or introduce contract changes in a new version using explicit versioning constructs.
intentAssessments.actual: Changing @armCommonTypesVersion from v6 to v5 on the existing 2026-11-01-preview and 2026-11-02-preview members changes 109 operations and produces 237 request/response wire-schema differences.
intentAssessments.rationale: The official versioning guidance treats API evolution as changes introduced in versions without breaking existing clients, and the common-types guidance models new common-type revisions as new versions. Rebinding already-declared API versions to a different common-types revision changes their emitted wire contracts in place.
